{{Quote|I felt Sernpidal break and suffocate. Now I know what Alderaan was like.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Chewbacca (Dark Horse)">[[Star Wars: Chewbacca (2000)|''Star Wars: Chewbacca'' (2000)]]</ref>}}
'''Sernpidal''' was the fifth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Julevian system]], [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] only 115,000 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] from its [[Star/Legends|sun]], the most populous world of its [[Dalonbian sector/Legends|sector]]. 

==Description==
Sernpidal belonged to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories.]]<ref name="TEA" /> The surface of the planet was dusty, with subterranean agri-farms watered by aquifers. Damp ravines were occupied by slow, tough, tentacular creatures which comprised both the planet's flora and fauna.<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
[[File:DobidoSernpidal.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Dobido]] hurtles toward Sernpidal.]]
During the [[Jedi Civil War]], the planet was under the control of the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]], and served as a major Sith naval base in possession of sensitive military codes and equipment. Later on, at the beginning of the [[Great Galactic War|Great Galactic War,]] the Sernpidal government was replaced by a puppet government that sided with the Sith in the war.

In [[365 BBY]], it was settled by the [[Sernpidalian]]s fleeing the [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] of the planet [[Hettitite]], who reached an 8 million-strong population, the greatest in the sector.<ref name="TEA" />

The planet's large population caused it to be an effective target in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], when the [[Praetorite Vong]] placed a [[dovin basal]] on the surface of the planet outside [[Sernpidal City]], causing the smallest of its two [[Moon/Legends|moons]], [[Dobido]], to be pulled into the planet in a spiraling orbit. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and [[Anakin Solo]] made an [[Destruction of Sernpidal|attempt]] to evacuate as many people as possible, but Chewbacca was [[Death/Legends|lost]] in the process when Dobido hit the planet. A chunk of the hemisphere was almost split, stripping the atmosphere. The Yuuzhan Vong used a colony of [[Snail/Legends|snail]]-like [[Biot|builders]] on the broken fragments to digest and regrow them into a [[shipwomb]].

Later on, [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] led a successful [[Second Battle of Sernpidal|assault]] on the planet, thinking that the system held a superweapon, and destroyed all that remained of the planet.<ref name="TEA" />
